title: Quantile restrictions, revealed rankings, and the limits of multinomial choice
abstract: arXiv:2608.16708v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper analyzes when choice probabilities reveal rankings of deterministic utility indices in semiparametric discrete choice models. It begins with binary choice, where quantile thresholds guarantee ranking recovery, and shows that such thresholds can arise either from behavioral departures from utility maximization (e.g., limited attention) under exchangeable unobservables, or from non-exchangeable unobservables under standard utility maximization. These behavioral and distributional routes are then extended to multinomial choice. Under limited attention, balance restrictions on attention probabilities yield global linear ranking partitions which are robust to the distribution of unobservables and, given sufficiently rich joint variation in the differences of utility indices, are also necessary. translated_title: 分位数约束、揭示排序与多项式选择的极限
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.16708v1 公告类型：新 摘要：本文分析了在半参数离散选择模型中，选择概率何时能揭示确定性效用指数的排序。首先从二元选择开始，其中分位数阈值保证排序恢复，并表明这些阈值可能源于交换性不可观测变量下的行为偏离效用最大化（例如，有限注意力），或标准效用最大化下的非交换性不可观测变量。这些行为和分布路径随后扩展到多项式选择。在有限注意力下，注意力概率的平衡约束产生全局线性排序划分，这些划分对不可观测变量的分布具有稳健性，并且在效用指数差异的联合变化足够丰富时，也是必要的。缺乏所需的注意力约束时，相反的排序可能产生重叠的概率图像。在非交换性不可观测变量下，结果进一步扩展，揭示了排序恢复的额外限制。
tldr: 本文揭示了在离散选择模型中，分位数阈值和注意力平衡约束如何决定效用排序的识别，并指出了行为与分布路径下的必要条件和局限性。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals how quantile thresholds and attention balance restrictions determine the identification of utility rankings in discrete choice models, highlighting necessary conditions and limitations under behavioral and distributional pathways.
